subject: Cost Accounting
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Overheads General, in CBSE Class 11 Cost Accounting.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Cost Accounting (823), Unit-4: Overheads General, covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
